header: Week of Monday 9 November 2026 — built 2026-11-09 from 138 daily snapshots (2026-06-17 to 2026-11-09), 5,854 pieces with a price record across 211 labels.
1033 pieces changed price and 978 of those moves are confirmed by a later snapshot; the biggest is 53% at Miaou.
302 pieces are down to one or two in-stock sizes from a run of four or more, and 983 were listed by their own shop in the last 7 days.
